name: zoom-blur
title: Zoom Blur
description: A quick cross-zoom: the outgoing scene swells and blurs out while the next scene scales up from slightly small and sharpens. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .zmb-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A short, soft scene change between connected beats.
Quick montages where each scene should hand over cleanly.
avoidWhen: You want a dramatic, long transition: use push-through or hyperspace.
Scenes already contain a lot of blur or zoom of their own.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Blur
variables.description: Peak blur on the outgoing and incoming scene.

variables.label: Rise
variables.description: Optional upward drift in pixels (0 keeps both scenes in place).
